name: elwynn-trough-shadow
about: Standing in the water trough at the Eastvale paddock, the camera zoomed in. The trough's shadow got a character's extra darkness: a rule took any model within 3 yards of the player for the player's (2026-10-04, the owner). The trough must not be marked a body.

start.about: the owner's place, read with ComfyTest pos; the camera faced -2.4 degrees, 23.8 down; the sun from the owner's probe, (0.62 0.62 0.48)

expect.about: The trough is drawn under you as a model and not a body: a draw with a bone within half a yard of you that is not your own. Not by its buffer: the client batches doodads into buffers that differ each session (78,336 bytes when the test was written, 13,824 and 44,544 on 2026-10-04)
expect.probe: model draw a model, not a body, .*nearest of [0-9]+ bones 0[.][0-4][0-9] yd
